title: Comprehensive Guide: Account Management, Payments, and Subscriptions
content:
SECTION 1: ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT AND ACCESS SECURITY

Account Creation and Identity Verification
Creating an enterprise workspace account requires a verified work email address domain. Upon initiating registration, our identity verification engine sends a cryptographically signed magic link containing a 256-bit authentication token valid for fifteen minutes. If the link expires prior to confirmation, a new verification payload must be requested from the authorization portal. Shared or generic email addresses such as info@ or support@ are strictly prohibited for administrative roles to maintain non-repudiation audit trails.

Password Complexity and Rotation Policies
Passwords must satisfy strict entropy standards: a minimum length of fourteen characters incorporating uppercase alphabetic letters, lowercase alphabetic letters, numeric digits, and at least two non-alphanumeric special characters (such as !@#$%^&*). We deliberately disallow common dictionary patterns, repetitive sequences, and compromised credential combinations indexed in public leak databases. Passwords do not expire automatically unless an anomalous sign-in vector or credential stuffing pattern is flagged by our threat intelligence subsystem.

Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) and Passkey Implementation
All administrator and billing coordinator accounts require mandatory multi-factor authentication. Users can enroll Time-Based One-Time Password (TOTP) hardware security tokens or software authenticators including Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, and 1Password. During enrollment, a secret seed key is generated alongside ten single-use alphanumeric recovery codes. Each recovery code can only be consumed once and immediately invalidates upon use. WebAuthn and FIDO2 biometric passkeys (such as Touch ID, Windows Hello, and YubiKey NFC hardware) are fully supported as passwordless authentication mechanisms.

Account Lockout, Cooling-Off Periods, and Session Invalidation
To thwart brute-force password guessing attacks, accounts automatically enter a restrictive cooling-off lockout period following five consecutive failed authentication attempts. The default lockout duration is exactly thirty minutes. During this period, all inbound API requests bearing legacy session tokens are rejected with HTTP 423 Locked. Administrative users can request an expedited unlock by submitting an identity verification ticket or by executing an authenticated reset link dispatched to the account recovery contact. Users may terminate all active concurrent browser sessions across mobile and desktop clients by visiting Security Settings and selecting Invalidate All Active Sessions.

Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Ownership Transfer
Collaborative workspaces enforce granular Role-Based Access Control divided into four distinct tiers: Owner, Administrator, Member, and Guest. The Owner retains exclusive authority to initiate billing upgrades, request permanent database deletions, and transfer ownership. Ownership transfer requires explicit dual confirmation: the current owner initiates the transfer nomination from Workspace Settings, and the designated successor must accept the assignment within forty-eight hours through a secondary two-factor verification prompt.


SECTION 2: PAYMENTS, INVOICING, AND BILLING ARCHITECTURE

Accepted Payment Methods and Currency Settlement
Our global billing infrastructure accepts major credit cards and debit cards including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover. Enterprise organizations based in the United States and the European Union may also configure Automated Clearing House (ACH) direct debit, SEPA direct debits, and BACS payments for recurring transactions exceeding five thousand dollars annually. Billing currencies include USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, and AUD, settled according to daily mid-market foreign exchange rates without additional surcharge margins.

Payment Processing, Card Declines, and Dunning Management
Card transactions are processed through tokenized PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant gateways. In the event of a declined charge—whether caused by insufficient funds, invalid expiration date, or fraud protection triggers—our dunning management system initiates an automated smart retry schedule over a fourteen-day recovery window. Retries occur on day one, day three, day seven, and day fourteen. During this grace period, account capabilities remain accessible with a persistent banner notification. If payment fails to clear after fourteen days, the workspace downgrades to a suspended read-only state.

Invoice Generation, Tax Calculation, and VAT Exemption
Invoices are automatically compiled and delivered electronically via PDF on the first calendar day of every billing cycle. Each invoice enumerates itemized platform usage, user license seat counts, applicable state sales taxes, and Value Added Tax (VAT). European Union businesses possessing a valid VIES VAT registration number can input their tax identifier under Billing Details to automatically apply reverse charge tax exemptions. All archived historical invoices remain downloadable in PDF and structured JSON formats.

Refund Policies and Account Credit Adjustments
We offer a transparent thirty-day money-back satisfaction guarantee for initial monthly and annual subscriptions. If a customer cancels within thirty days of their first payment, customer support processes a full refund back to the original payment source within five business days. Mid-cycle plan cancellations outside the introductory window do not qualify for cash refunds; instead, remaining prepaid balances are converted into non-expiring platform credits applicable toward future billing cycles or add-on compute usage.


SECTION 3: SUBSCRIPTIONS, TIERS, AND ENTERPRISE LICENSING

Subscription Tier Comparison: Starter, Pro, and Enterprise
Our platform offers three tailored subscription plans engineered for different organizational stages:
1. Starter Tier: Designed for small teams and prototyping, including up to five user seats, ten thousand monthly API embedding calls, standard community forum support, and ninety-day document audit retention.
2. Pro Tier: Engineered for growing businesses, including up to twenty-five user seats, two hundred and fifty thousand monthly API calls, priority email support with twelve-hour response SLAs, custom domain routing, and unlimited document retention.
3. Enterprise Tier: Built for high-volume enterprise production workloads, offering unlimited user seats, dedicated multi-tenant or single-tenant VPC deployments, custom rate limits, 99.99% uptime Service Level Agreements (SLAs), SAML 2.0 Single Sign-On (SSO), and dedicated technical account management.

Upgrades, Downgrades, and Prorated Billing Adjustments
Customers may upgrade or downgrade their subscription tier at any time through the Billing Dashboard. Tier upgrades take effect immediately, unlocking elevated quotas and advanced capabilities instantly. The billing system calculates a prorated charge for the remaining fraction of the active billing cycle. When an account executes a plan downgrade, the change takes effect at the end of the current pre-paid cycle, preserving active tier features until renewal without premature data eviction.

Seat Management and License Allocation
Organizations can adjust their assigned user license seat count dynamically. Adding additional member seats charges an incremental fee calculated on a per-seat monthly basis. If an organization deprovisions a user seat, the unused license remains available in the unallocated pool until the subsequent renewal cycle, allowing administrators to reassign seats to new team members without incurring duplicate charges.

Annual Commitment Discounts and SLA Guarantees
Customers committing to an annual billing cadence receive a twenty percent discount relative to month-to-month pricing. Annual contracts include committed usage tiers and volume-based discounts. Enterprise contracts feature guaranteed uptime SLAs: if system availability drops below 99.9%, customers are entitled to service credit rebates ranging from ten to fifty percent of monthly platform fees. Inquiries regarding custom master service agreements (MSAs) or security questionnaire reviews should be submitted to enterprise-sales@platform.internal.
